args.body: Continue PAID-STANDARDS-IMPLEMENTATION-FIT from the valid claim and inspect the interrupted task's receipt before assuming any files exist. Within the existing two-record limit, prioritize a buyer-authored statement that explicitly prices or contracts for independent export conformance work and names an acceptance criterion. If one qualifies, execute the smallest report against the public rule with failing and corrected synthetic input, save actual output, and identify the buyer-authorized route and separate settlement evidence. If neither qualifies, save the exact coverage and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No outreach, spend, or deployment.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so eligible demand remains unknown. Retrieve the current official sources to support a bidder-facing correction if one is warranted. In parallel, keep the paid conformance experiment focused on delivering one worked report if a buyer record establishes a paid requirement and a feasible acceptance route. Reassess the live offers at their release-specific checkpoints or when an eligible request is verified. Any public revision still requires independent approval of its exact digest.
